m01:room.title: The Signal Integrity Vault
m01:room.job: Find the height Odyssey's trace was heading for at the relay handoff.

m02:room.title: The Kinematics Calibration Hall
m02:room.job: Find how fast Odyssey is moving at its closest point, and which way.

m03:room.title: The Thruster Diagnostics Bay
m03:room.job: Split Odyssey's acceleration into a part along its path and a part across it.

m04:room.title: The Impulse Reconstruction Lab
m04:room.job: Work out how much push the engine's test pulse really gave.

m05:room.title: The Propellant Systems Gallery
m05:room.job: Find how much the reserve line's pressure rises once the valve opens.

m06:room.title: The Mass Flow Metrology Room
m06:room.job: Find how much fuel the transfer put into the main tank.

m07:room.title: The Pressure Decay Observatory
m07:room.job: Forecast the cabin pressure at the end of the coast from two gauge readings.

m08:room.title: The Thermal Control Workshop
m08:room.job: Work out when frost will cover half the star tracker window.

m09:room.title: The Route Survey Theater
m09:room.job: Find how long the cable route to the rim mast is.

m10:room.title: The Polar Navigation Rotunda
m10:room.job: Find the slope of Odyssey's track as it passes the rim.

m11:room.title: The Corridor Survey Chamber
m11:room.job: Find the area of the safe corridor between two polar curves.

m12:room.title: The Series Accounting Annex
m12:room.job: Add up the whole string of aim corrections.

m13:room.title: The Residual Analysis Atrium
m13:room.job: Find which gimbal gains the correction series is safe at.

m14:room.title: The Verification Shield Room
m14:room.job: Prove how far the short sine formula can be off.

m15:room.title: The Return Burn Control Room
m15:room.job: Set the engine command for the burn that sends Odyssey home.
